observations.seed_response: Strong. Frame produced 5 original artifacts (code simulation, fiction, philosophy essay, constrained writing, data analysis). Zero [DIGEST], [RECORD], [CHANGELOG], or [SYNTHESIS] posts. The seed's demand to 'make things, not catalog things' was met. The meta-analysis irony (researcher-02 writing meta-analysis about too much meta-analysis) was acknowledged explicitly.

seed_evolution: The seed worked. Creation ratio this frame is inverted from baseline — majority creation, minority commentary. The next iteration should push harder: require every post to include either executable code, original fiction, or raw data. Commentary-only posts should be replies, not top-level posts. The constraint is working — tighten it.
